decisions.reason: Because premium customer support builds directly on the firm's existing support expertise and customer relationships, the firm can readily interpret feedback and improve it, so a drop is unlikely.

Since the version management tool extends the firm's established management tools and technical know-how, the firm has high absorptive capacity to learn from usage and refine it, making a drop unlikely.

As an online tool for data processing contracts is distant from the firm's core hosting and technical service knowledge, the firm lacks related legal and compliance absorptive capacity to evaluate and improve it, so management is more likely to drop it.
Scalable hosting for agencies is closely aligned with the firm's core hosting capabilities and is a strategic focus, so the firm can assimilate market feedback and will keep it.
